Coverage cutoff is September 14, 2026. Mayor history records Katie Wilson taking office January 1, 2026. February special-election page contains school measures; August primary candidate list contains Seattle council and court offices but no mayor. April special-election completeness not independently verified; retain unresolved calendar rather than infer no election. Second pass: the Seattle Municipal Archives mayors page states the 1946 charter set a four-year mayoral term, and that state law since 1967 puts city elections in odd-numbered years with terms starting January 1 of the next even-numbered year. Katie Wilson, elected November 2025, began a four-year term on January 1, 2026, so no regular mayoral election falls in 2026. The King County 2026 results index lists only the February special, the King Conservation District election, the August primary and the November general; the August primary candidate list has no mayor, and the February special has school measures only. The April special-election URL returned HTTP 404. No vacancy occurred in 2026, so no special mayoral election was found. Status set to no_election.
